_note: Daily zone conditions (VARIETY_PLAN V3). Each zone gets one a day, picked by weight from a seed of the day and the zone, like the bounty board. A hunt keeps the condition it started with. battle: dodgeBonus is added to every fighter's dodge (1 point is 1 percent to hit); elementBoost multiplies the player side's hits of the condition's element; breathPerRound is added to every partner dragon's breath each round. rewards: gold multiplies gold, dropPct adds to item drop chances, gearChance multiplies the zone gear chance. A condition with zoneElement picks one of the zone's elements and fills {element}.

conditions.name: Calm
conditions.text: A quiet day. Nothing out of the ordinary.

conditions.name: Fog
conditions.text: Thick fog rolls in. Everyone dodges more, friend and foe.

conditions.name: {element} surge
conditions.text: The air hums with {element}. Your {element} hits are 20 percent stronger.

conditions.name: Full moon
conditions.text: A full moon tonight. Champions and rares show up twice as often.

conditions.name: Bounty day
conditions.text: The town is paying double. Fights here give twice the gold.

conditions.name: Tailwind
conditions.text: A steady wind at your back. Your dragons' breath fills faster.

conditions.name: Treasure trail
conditions.text: Fresh tracks lead to old stashes. Better odds of items and gear.
